message: Record the review of phase 6: two findings, fixed

title: Take two-field and CR-terminated affect records in the audit recipe
message:
Take two-field and CR-terminated affect records in the audit recipe

The world-file grep recorded for the next arm-feat audit needed a
trailing space after the feat, which a two-field A line has not
(parse_object() takes two fields; four such lines on each side, none at
location 49), and matched only an LF-terminated header, while get_line()
strips a trailing CR. The recipe now takes both forms, by a POSIX class
rather than a CR in the pattern, since the development grep is ugrep,
which breaks a pattern at a CR, and $'...' turns \? into ?. It also says
that a prototype's own affects never reach serialized_obj, so the world
grep on the files production loads is the only check for them. The
counts do not change: 33 location-49 records on both sides, none 1320
or 1321.

title: Audit house_data, the table House_load() reads, for arm feats
message:
Audit house_data, the table House_load() reads, for arm feats

The phase 6 audit read the lib/house files, which House_load() opens only
to see that a house exists; its objects come from house_data, as a
character's come from player_save_objs. The query ran read-only on
production: 7951 rows over 44 houses, none with feat 1320 or 1321. The
audit table, the recipe and the development count name the table.

title: Record phase 6 of the object save fixes: built, in review as MR !29
message:
Record phase 6 of the object save fixes: built, in review as MR !29

The phase record: the read-only audit of feat 1320 and 1321 grants on the
world files, the production and development player files, the object save
tables and the house and crash files (no Extra Arms anywhere, Four Arms only
on a Thri-Kreen), the recipe for the next audit, the pricing decisions
written into the races reference, the monk third hand confirmed in
plan_second_pair(), and the verification.

title: Price Extra Arms by the arm it adds and keep the monk third hand inside Four Arms
message:
Price Extra Arms by the arm it adds and keep the monk third hand inside Four Arms

Work item #1. The reference priced Extra Arms at 3 RP per rank, set when a
rank was one extra swing, and said the price was under review. A rank is now
one full arm (arm_count()), so an arm is priced by what it opens: the third
arm 9 RP (three worn positions and a weapon hand that mirrors the first
pair's primary chain), the fourth 6 RP (a fourth wrist and the hand that
makes the pair dual), each arm past four 1 RP. The two add up to Four Arms'
15 RP, since two ranks and Four Arms are the same four arms, and a race is
priced by the count it ends with, whatever mix of sources gives it; a
negative arm_adjust is a drawback by the lost-slot row. The single-trait cap
exemption stays Thri-Kreen's alone. The monk's empty third hand is the same
swing a weapon there makes (plan_second_pair() plans one third-hand chain),
so it is class interaction, not priced, and inside the 15 RP.
